blocks.text: Jandaron (organism) ki classification ek hierarchy ki shakal mein ki jati hai, yani darjon (levels) ka ek nizam (system). Is se scientists jandaron ko groups mein rakh sakte hain aur zindagi ki mukhtalif shaklon ke darmiyan rishtey samajh sakte hain. Har darja ek taxon kehlata hai (jama: taxa) aur biological classification ka ek rank hai. Buniyadi darje yeh hain: kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus aur species. Kingdom se upar domain hota hai.

blocks.title: Taxon aur taxonomic hierarchy
blocks.text: Taxon biological classification ka koi ek rank ya darja hai, jaise family ya genus. Taxonomic hierarchy in ranks ki tarteeb (order)-war (ordered) seerhi (ladder) hai, sab se bare (domain) se sab se chhote aur khaas (species) tak. Jaise jaise neeche jaate hain, har group ke jandar ek doosre se zyada milte julte hote jaate hain.

blocks.alt: Taxonomic hierarchy nau (9) ek doosre ke neeche latakti ghanti-numa (bell) satahon ki shakal mein: sab se upar All Organisms, phir Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, aur sab se neeche Species. Har satah ke saath us ka naam ek khaane mein likha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: Taxonomic hierarchy (kitab ki Figure 1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Upar se neeche parhein. Sab se upar All Organisms hain, yani tamam jandar. Har agla darja (rank) apne se upar wale darje ke andar se nikalta hai aur us mein kam jandar hote hain. Domain sab se wasee (broadest) rank hai aur Species sab se khaas (most specific): ek species sirf ek qisam ke jandar ki hoti hai. Har ghanti ke neeche ke soorakh dikhate hain ke ek bara group kai chhote groups mein batta hai.
Ranks, ek ek kar ke
1. Domain
Domain classification ka sab se ooncha darja hai. Is waqt teen domains hain: Archaea, Bacteria aur Eukarya.
2. Kingdom

Kingdom sab se oonche ranks mein se ek hai, domain se bilkul neeche. Yeh un tamam jandaron ko ikattha karta hai jo buniyadi khasoosiyat share karte hain. Misal: domain Eukarya mein kai kingdoms hain, jaise Animalia (janwar), Plantae (poday), Fungi (fungi) aur Protista (protists).
3. Phylum

Phylum kingdom se neeche agla darja hai. Ek phylum ke jandaron ka buniyadi body plan aur aham structural khasoosiyat ek jaisi hoti hain. Misal: kingdom Animalia mein phylum Chordata un tamam janwaron ko shamil karta hai jin mein notochord hota hai, jaise mammals, parinde (birds), reptiles, amphibians aur machhliyan (fish).
4. Class

Class ek phylum ke jandaron ko zyada khaas mushtarak (shared) khasoosiyat ki buniyad par aage taqseem karta hai. Misal: phylum Chordata ke andar class Mammalia mein tamam mammals aate hain, jin ki pehchaan baal (hair) aur mammary glands (doodh ke ghadood) hain.
5. Order

Order ek class ke jandaron ko mazeed mushtarak khasoosiyat aur evolutionary tareekh ki buniyad par groups mein rakhta hai. Misal: class Mammalia ke andar order Primates mein insaan, bandar (monkeys) aur apes aate hain, jin ki pehchaan bara dimagh aur opposable thumbs (angoothay jo baqi ungliyon ke saamne aa sakte hain) hain.
6. Family

Family ek order ke un jandaron ko ikattha karti hai jo aur bhi qareebi rishtedar hain aur zyada khaas mushtarak khasoosiyat rakhte hain. Misal: order Primates ke andar family Hominidae mein great apes aur insaan shamil hain.
7. Genus

Genus family ke andar ek zyada khaas rank hai. Is mein aisi species aati hain jo bohat qareebi rishtedar hain aur aksar dekhne mein ek jaisi lagti hain. Misal: family Hominidae ke andar genus Homo mein insaan aur hamare sab se qareebi khatam ho chuke (extinct) rishtedar shamil hain.
8. Species

Species classification ka sab se khaas darja hai aur jandar ki ek hi qisam ko zahir karta hai. Ek species ke afraad aapas mein interbreed kar sakte hain (afzaish kar sakte hain) aur aisi aulad paida karte hain jo khud bhi aulad paida kar sake (fertile offspring). Misal: genus Homo ke andar species Homo sapiens aaj ke insaan hain.

blocks.title: Tarteeb yaad rakhne ka tareeqa
blocks.text: Domain, Kingdom, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species: pehle huroof D-K-P-C-O-F-G-S banate hain. Har rank apne se agle rank ko apne andar rakhta hai, aur neeche jaate hue har group mein jandaron ki tadaad (number) kam hoti jaati hai.
Teen jandaron ki classification

blocks.caption: Insaan, chiriya (sparrow) aur pyaaz (onion) ke taxonomic ranks

blocks.text: Table ko upar se neeche (column mein) parhein to ek jandar ki poori classification milti hai; ek row ko daayein baayein parhein to teen jandaron ka ek hi rank par muqabla (comparison) hota hai. Insaan aur chiriya phylum Chordata tak sab kuch share karte hain aur class par alag hote hain. Pyaaz kingdom par hi dono se alag ho jata hai, kyunke woh poda hai. Yeh bhi dekhein ke species ka naam do hisson ka hota hai: pehle genus ka naam bare harf se, phir species ka naam; dono italics mein ya underline kar ke likhe jate hain.

blocks.title: Classification parhna
blocks.problem: In teen jandaron mein se kaun se do sab se qareebi rishtedar hain, aur kis rank par woh ek group share karna chhor dete hain?
steps: Columns ko upar se mila kar dekhein. Insaan, chiriya aur pyaaz teenon domain Eukarya mein hain.
Kingdom par insaan aur chiriya dono Animalia hain; pyaaz Plantae hai. Is liye pyaaz sab se kam rishtedar hai.
Insaan aur chiriya dono phylum Chordata mein hain, lekin class par insaan Mammalia hai aur chiriya Aves.
blocks.answer: Insaan aur chiriya sab se qareebi rishtedar hain. Un ka domain, kingdom aur phylum ek hai, aur woh class ke rank par alag hote hain.

blocks.text: Mukhtasir khulasa

items: Taxon classification ka ek rank hai; taxonomic hierarchy ranks ki tarteeb-war seerhi hai.
Sab se bare se sab se khaas tak: domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species.
Domain sab se ooncha rank hai (Archaea, Bacteria, Eukarya); species sab se neecha, jandar ki ek qisam jis ke afraad aapas mein afzaish (reproduction) kar ke fertile aulad paida karte hain.
Insaan: Eukarya, Animalia, Chordata, Mammalia, Primates, Hominidae, Homo, Homo sapiens.

blocks.prompt: Aath ranks tarteeb se likhein, phir ghar ki chiriya (house sparrow) ka class aur order batayein.
blocks.explanation: Domain, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species. Chiriya class Aves aur order Passeriformes mein hai.
